# Cast Bridge

A single-page web app that puts a video link on a TV. Paste a direct media
address, or give it a webpage and it reads the media off the page server-side,
then hands the stream to a Chromecast (Google Cast), an AirPlay target, or VLC.

No account, no tracking, no ads, no analytics. History lives in the browser's
own localStorage and never leaves the device.

What it cannot do: DRM services. Netflix, Disney+, Hotstar, Prime Video, Max,
Viu, iQIYI, sooka and Astro GO encrypt their video and only decrypt inside a
licensed player, so no address on those pages is playable on a TV. The app says
so explicitly rather than returning an empty result or a marketing trailer.
